messages:
Maya (Design): Quick check-in: new responsive pass pushed for sidebar collapse + table overflow. On narrow widths we hide secondary columns and provide a floating sort pill. Please test breakpoints and A11y copy. :mag_right:
Elaine (Frontend): Prototype uses breakpoints at 520px (full->compressed rows) and 420px (rows->cards). Small CSS snippet: `@media (max-width:520px){.col-secondary{display:none}}`. Noted iOS keyboard covers action row when filters open.
Samir (Product): Prefer keeping compact rows until 480 if possible. Also change header copy to "Filter results" and close button aria-label to "Close filters".
Nora (A11y): Confirmed: when DOM switches from table to list, use `role="list"` + `role="listitem"`. Add `aria-live="polite"` for filter open/close announcements. Chips must be keyboard focusable with `role="button"` and `aria-pressed`.
Elaine (Frontend): Will implement visualViewport listener to detect keyboard and add `.keyboard-open` class to raise the sheet; will debounce resize to avoid mid-scroll layout flips. Adding sticky sort via `position:sticky; top:env(safe-area-inset-top,16px);`.
Maya (Design): Uploaded updated frames with compact-row specs and sticky pill spacing: https://www.figma.com/file/unique/mobile-sidebar-responsive. QA checklist in the figma notes.
DeployBot: staging preview: https://staging.redwood.internal/responsive-sidebar-1939 (build 2026.03.23-22) :rocket:
Samir (Product): I'll test on iPhone SE and Pixel 6. If no surprises, we'll roll compressed rows at 520 -> 480 decision.
Elaine (Frontend): Opening small PR referencing INF-1102 with debounce, keyboard handling, and ARIA changes. Planning device tests today.
Maya (Design): Thanks all 44d. Please leave quick screenshots here after device testing and we'll finalize breakpoints in the design sync.
